# Support

## Questions and usage help

Read the guides first:

- [Installation](../docs/installation.md) and [configuration](../docs/configuration.md)
- [FAQ](../docs/faq.md)
- [Console commands](../docs/console.md)

If the answer is not there, search the existing issues and then open a new one with the bug report
template. Include the PHP, MySQL and Node versions and the exact steps to reproduce.

## Bug reports and feature requests

Use the templates in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`. A report with a failing test or a minimal
reproduction gets fixed much faster.

## Security issues

Do not open a public issue. Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) and use GitHub's private advisory
form.

## Contributing

[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) covers local setup, the checks a pull request must pass and
the commit format. Everyone taking part is expected to follow the
[code of conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
